claim: Sampling 50k 32x32 images from a DDPM takes about 20 hours vs under a minute for a GAN on an Nvidia 2080 Ti; 50k 256x256 images take nearly 1000 hours
The DDPM objective L_gamma depends only on the marginals q(x_t|x_0), not on the joint forward process, so non-Markovian forward processes with the same marginals share it
For all sigma > 0 the non-Markovian variational objective equals a reweighted DDPM objective up to a constant
DDIM's alpha_t denotes DDPM's cumulative alpha-bar_t
Generalized sampling step = sqrt(alpha_{t-1}) * predicted x0 + sqrt(1 - alpha_{t-1} - sigma_t^2) * eps_theta + sigma_t * noise
sigma_tau_i(eta) = eta * sqrt((1-alpha_{tau_{i-1}})/(1-alpha_{tau_i})) * sqrt(1 - alpha_{tau_i}/alpha_{tau_{i-1}}); eta = 1 is DDPM, eta = 0 is DDIM
All experiments reuse the same trained model with T = 1000 and gamma = 1; only the sampler (tau, sigma) changes
Sub-sequence tau chosen quadratic (floor(c i^2)) for CIFAR-10 and linear (floor(c i)) for other datasets
